sentences.en: It is not ethical for a doctor to reveal confidences.
sentences.zh: 医生泄露病人隐私是不道德的行为。

sentences.en: I don't think it would be ethical to do that.
sentences.zh: 我认为这样做不符合伦理。

sentences.en: I think it might not be ethical to do that.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这样做可能不太符合伦理。

phrases.zh: 行为/行事是合乎道德的

senses.zh: 道德的；伦理的；凭处方出售的 -
